candidate.title: A clinical benchmark of public self-supervised pathology foundation models.
candidate.abstract: The use of self-supervised learning to train pathology foundation models has increased substantially in the past few years. Notably, several models trained on large quantities of clinical data have been made publicly available in recent months. This will significantly enhance scientific research in computational pathology and help bridge the gap between research and clinical deployment. With the increase in availability of public foundation models of different sizes, trained using different algorithms on different datasets, it becomes important to establish a benchmark to compare the performance of such models on a variety of clinically relevant tasks spanning multiple organs and diseases. In this work, we present a collection of pathology datasets comprising clinical slides associated with clinically relevant endpoints including cancer diagnoses and a variety of biomarkers generated during standard hospital operation from three medical centers. We leverage these datasets to systematically assess the performance of public pathology foundation models and provide insights into best practices for training foundation models and selecting appropriate pretrained models. To enable the community to evaluate their models on our clinical datasets, we make available an automated benchmarking pipeline for external use.
candidate.authors: Campanella G, Chen S, Singh M, Verma R, Muehlstedt S, Zeng J, Stock A, Croken M, Veremis B, Elmas A, Shujski I, Neittaanmäki N, Huang KL, Kwan R, Houldsworth J, Schoenfeld AJ, Vanderbilt C.

extraction.method: 病理自监督基础模型临床基准评测
extraction.data: 全切片图像(WSI)，多机构病理数据
extraction.scenario: 病理基础模型临床任务评测
extraction.results: 系统比较各模型参数量、算法与训练数据，评估下游临床任务性能

extraction.summary: 文章对公开自监督病理基础模型进行临床基准评测。介绍SSL在病理领域的进展，汇总各模型的算法、训练数据规模与分辨率。通过多下游任务比较不同基础模型性能，指出数据与算力是主要瓶颈。
